items.q: How do I choose the best keywords from the list?
items.a: Pick keywords that match what you sell, show clear intent and are specific enough for you to compete. Then check volume and competition in Google Keyword Planner.

items.q: Are these keywords guaranteed to rank?
items.a: No. They are ideas based on how people search. Rankings depend on your content, links and the competition.

items.q: Is the keyword ideas generator free?
items.a: Yes. The keyword ideas generator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
